assumptions: Footnote 5 elaborates paragraph 14's content without removing its express request condition.
The formalization selects only the condition activating paragraph 14 demonstration, not confirmation, satisfactory demonstration or overall compliance.

citations.quote: Product Providers should confirm and, upon SFC’s request, demonstrate to the SFC’s satisfaction the management and operational soundness of the tokenisation arrangement, record keeping of ownership and the integrity of the smart contracts5.

5 Product Providers should confirm and demonstrate to the SFC that, at a minimum, they comply with the requirements as set out in paragraphs 10 to 13 above and the smart contracts are not subject to any contract vulnerabilities or security flaws with a high level of confidence.

Product Providers should, upon SFC’s request, obtain third party audit or verification on the management and operational soundness of the tokenisation arrangement, record keeping of ownership and integrity of the smart contracts.
Product Providers should, upon SFC’s request, obtain satisfactory legal opinion to support its application.

deferred.a2190f7599ca8c478be5d897.distinction: A provider that has confirmed the specified matters but received no SFC request has no activated paragraph 14 demonstration requirement on this reading. Confirmation and underlying requirements continue. Paragraph 15 separately calls for obtaining third-party audit or verification on request; paragraph 16 calls for a satisfactory legal opinion supporting the application on request. Neither evidential method is automatically required by paragraph 14.

facts.meaning: The assessed entity is a Product Provider within the supplied paragraph 14's applicable scope.
facts.name: provider_in_scope

facts.meaning: By the assessment time, the SFC has made a request applicable to this provider for the demonstration described in paragraph 14.
facts.name: sfc_demonstration_requested

questions: How is confirmation communicated and renewed?
Does the SFC satisfaction standard extend beyond demonstration, and how far does the confidence qualification extend in footnote 5?
deferred.a2190f7599ca8c478be5d897.statement: [TRUE_IS_SATISFIED] Within Product Provider scope, true means that the request condition activating paragraph 14 demonstration is satisfied; false means it is not. Confirmation remains unqualified by that trigger. Both acts concern management and operational soundness, ownership record keeping and smart-contract integrity. Footnote 5 supplies minimum content: compliance with paragraphs 10–13 and assurance, with high confidence, of freedom from contract vulnerabilities or security flaws. The strongest grammatical reading attaches SFC satisfaction to demonstration and high confidence to the smart-contract assurance; broader attachment remains unresolved.
deferred.a2190f7599ca8c478be5d897.subject: Paragraph 14 demonstration triggered by an SFC request

deferred.a2190f7599ca8c478be5d897.question: By the assessment time, has the SFC made a request applicable to this Product Provider for the paragraph 14 demonstration?
deferred.a2190f7599ca8c478be5d897.unit_of_assessment: One provider's paragraph 14 demonstration trigger for its tokenisation arrangement.
deferred.a2190f7599ca8c478be5d897.temporal_basis: Requests made by assessment; confirmation communication, renewal and demonstration deadlines are not determined.
deferred.a2190f7599ca8c478be5d897.true_means: Paragraph 14 demonstration is activated, not completed. It covers soundness, records and integrity, including footnote 5's minimum matters. SFC satisfaction most naturally qualifies demonstration and high confidence the smart-contract assurance; broader attachment remains unresolved. Audit and legal-opinion duties require their respective requests.
deferred.a2190f7599ca8c478be5d897.false_means: The request condition is unsatisfied and paragraph 14 demonstration is untriggered under this reading. Unconditional confirmation and substantive duties remain.
